items.html: But the letters of BaDaK, Haya — which are vessels of the backs of AVI [Abba ve-Ima], as explained above, since AVI took two lights, that of the nose and that of the mouth, and lacked from them only the light of the ear — therefore only the aspect of the backs came down from them. And corresponding to that single light of the ear that was lacking from them, we mark each of their letters with a single tag [crownlet] alone, since that light alone departed from it, standing suspended above the letter, which is a vessel.
